Class SshClientApp.SshEditQueue

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshClientApp.SshEditQueue
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
Enclosing class:
SshClientApp
private final class SshClientApp.SshEditQueue extends Object implements Runnable
The SshEditQueue counts SSH line edits off the Swing thread. The queue keeps only the newest edit that has not started. The worker copies the snapshot on the Swing thread. The worker does not paint. The keyboard path does not wait for the worker. // @aa-sdd PK-1088 docs/specs/common/formal-plan.spec.md FINESSE:f-192

  • Constructor Details

    • SshEditQueue

      SshEditQueue()
      The constructor creates the daemon thread. The thread name is ssh-token-edit. The thread is not started here.

  • Method Details

    • ensureStarted

      void ensureStarted()
      The ensureStarted method starts the worker once. A started queue returns immediately. The check is repeated under the gate before start is called.

    • offer

      void offer(SshClientApp.SshEdit edit)
      The offer method keeps only the newest edit. The call is expected on the Swing thread. The pending queue is cleared. The new edit is added. Waiting workers are notified.
      Parameters:
      edit - The pane post.

    • run

      public void run()
      The run method counts edits until the process ends. A null take is skipped. An edit that already has a newer one waiting is skipped. A null snapshot is skipped. A snapshot older than sshEditSeq is skipped. A count that throws is skipped. A snapshot that became old during the count is skipped. paintLater(SshClientApp.SshSeat, int) posts the count to the Swing thread.
      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable

    • take

      private SshClientApp.SshEdit take()
      The take method waits for the next edit. An empty queue waits on the gate. An interrupt leaves the wait and tries again. The first pending edit is removed and returned.
      Returns:
      The next edit.

    • newerWaiting

      private boolean newerWaiting()
      The newerWaiting method reports a newer edit already queued. The result is true when the pending queue is not empty.
      Returns:
      True when a newer edit is waiting.

    • capture

      private SshClientApp.SshSeat capture(SshClientApp.SshEdit edit)
      The capture method copies the pane on the Swing thread and waits. A failure returns null.
      Parameters:
      edit - The edit to copy.
      Returns:
      The snapshot, or null.

    • paintLater

      private void paintLater(SshClientApp.SshSeat seat, int count)
      The paintLater method posts the count to the Swing thread.
      Parameters:
      seat - The snapshot that was counted.
